name: Nostalgic Tag‎‎
summary:
"Nostalgic Tag‎‎" is a captivating VR game designed to immerse players in a tranquil yet engaging environment. Set in a serene virtual world filled with lush picturesque scenery, the game offers a unique experience of relaxation and creativity.
The objective of "Nostalgic Tag‎‎" is simple yet delightful: players use virtual reality tools to create beautiful, glowing art installations throughout the game world.
These installations can take the form of intricate patterns.
